q: How can I open a new savings account?
a: You can open a savings account online via Internet Banking or visit the nearest branch with valid ID and address proof.

q: What is the minimum balance for a regular savings account?
a: Maintain an average monthly balance of ₹5,000 to avoid non-maintenance charges.

q: How do I reset my Internet Banking password?
a: Use the Forgot Password option on the login page and authenticate with your registered mobile number and debit card details.

q: How can I update my mailing address?
a: Submit the new address via the mobile app Profile section or visit a branch with address proof for verification.

q: What are the ATM withdrawal limits?
a: Classic debit cards allow ₹40,000 daily ATM withdrawals and Platinum cards allow up to ₹1,00,000 per day.

q: How do I report a lost debit card?
a: Immediately block the card through the mobile app or call the emergency helpline available 24x7.

q: Can I change my EMI due date?
a: Yes, you can request an EMI due date change once per loan tenure by contacting customer care at least 7 days before the next EMI.

q: What is the interest rate on a one-year fixed deposit?
a: A one-year fixed deposit currently offers an annual interest rate of 6.7% compounded quarterly.

q: How do I enable international transactions on my card?
a: Enable international usage through the card controls section of the mobile app or Internet Banking before your travel date.

q: How can I download my account statement?
a: Login to Internet Banking and navigate to Accounts > Download Statement to export PDF or Excel copies for the chosen period.

q: What charges apply for UPI transfers?
a: UPI transfers up to ₹1 lakh per transaction are free of charge for savings account customers.

q: How do I check my loan payoff amount?
a: Use the Loan summary in Internet Banking to view outstanding principal, accrued interest, and payoff amount updated daily.
